questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设}u=x^2y,v=3x-e^y,\ \text{则} \\& \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot 2xy+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot 3=f'+2xyf_2'+3f_3',\\& \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cdot 0+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot x^2-\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot e^y=x^2f_2'-e^yf_3'.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{由于混合偏导数在连续条件下与求导次序无关，可以先求} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \text{也可以先求} \frac{\partial}{\partial y}. \\ & \text{方法一：先求} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \text{由复合函数求导法，} \\ & \quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(2x-y)+g'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x)+g'_2(xy)=2f'+g'+yg'_1, \\ & \text{再对y求偏导，得} \\ & \quad\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2f'+g'+yg'_1)=2f'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x-y) \\ & \quad\quad+\left[g''_1\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+g''_2\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)\right]+\left[g'_2+yg''_1\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+yg''_2\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)\right]\\ & \quad=-2f'+g''_{11}\cdot0+xg''_{12}+g'_2+yg''_{21}-0+xyg''_{22}, \text{因此选B} \\ & \text{方法二：先求} \frac{\partial}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial}{\partial x}=f'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x-y)+g'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+g'_2(xy)=-f'+xg'_2, \\ & \text{再对x求偏导数，得}\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(-f'+xg') \\ & \quad=-f'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(2x-y)+g'+xg'_1\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x)+xg'_2\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(xy) \\ & \quad=-2f'+g'_2+xg''_{21}+xyg''_{22}, \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{令} u=2x, v=y^2/x,\;\; \text{则} \; z=xf(u,v)\; .\\ & \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y})=x(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot 0+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot \frac{2y}{x})=2y\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\; .\\ & \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=2y\left[\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right)\right]=2y(\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x})\; .\\ & \qquad=2y\left[\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot 2+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}\cdot\left(-\frac{y^2}{x^2}\right)\right]=4y\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}-\frac{2y^3}{x^2}\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}\;\; . \end{aligned}
